name: nrkp_2026_render_nodes
description: The six NRKP render nodes nrkp-node1 ... nrkp-node6, without the GUI machine. Use it to send media, files or folders to the render nodes only, e.g. from the GUI/master machine. Files and folders go to the same path on each node through the administrative shares d$ and e$, with the stored account 'nrkp_2026_cluster'.
